description: This file defines a utility enum 'CaptureRateLimits' with static methods to clamp duration in milliseconds and frames per second (fps) within specified bounds.

methods.name: clampDurationMs
methods.description: Clamps the input duration (ms) within min and max bounds, returning the clamped value.

methods.name: clampFps
methods.description: Clamps the input fps within min and max bounds, returning the clamped value.
